reply_text:
I found two new dated statements from 2025 and confirmed that one recorded claim was repeated. The new INBOUND line comes only from a recap written by the event's organiser, HubSpot, not from a transcript. The new 60 Minutes line is worded as a possibility ("could we…"), so it's on the edge of your hypothetical rule; you may want to drop it.

- **INBOUND 2025 (September, San Francisco):** HubSpot's recap of his talk quotes him saying AI will "go beyond the frontier of human knowledge" if progress continues for "maybe one to three more years". I didn't open the YouTube recording.
- **60 Minutes (16 November 2025), CBS's own transcript:** he describes compressing a century of medical progress into "five or 10 years" once AI can work with top scientists. In the same interview Anderson Cooper read back the earlier warning that AI could wipe out half of entry-level white-collar jobs in one to five years, and Amodei answered "Yes." That is the recorded Axios claim, so I've marked it as such.
- **DealBook Summit (3 December 2025):** nothing usable. The only dated line is about company revenue, so it's out. The Sources newsletter was paywalled partway through, and the Yahoo article's text didn't load.
- **Dreamforce (October 2025):** the page I opened had no dated quotes.
- **Not checked:** the October 2025 statement on American AI leadership. I didn't have its page address on anthropic.com, and coverage of it showed no timeline.

Several search results that looked like 2025 were actually from 2026 (the Dwarkesh podcast, the January 2026 essay, Davos 2026); they're listed under other_years. I used 11 of 12 searches and all 6 page openings. One opening (aydin.org) only loaded the site's homepage.
